input_changes.length: 150, fixed to separate size from implementation

sampler: public engine defaults (200 timesteps; allow_realignment default false), no custom noise injection
paired_scope: same task/seeds; #397 changes random stream so not identical noise across legacy/padded paths
primary_metric: pooled RMSD of 15 constrained chemical tip atoms across HIS/ASP/GLN/CYS BEFORE guidepost coordinate insertion, in the shared model frame; no tip fitting
secondary_metric: native insertion_rmsd, mean over six per-guidepost residue RMSDs
threshold_scope: descriptive cutoff from existing insertion metric documentation, not a population equivalence gate
selection_for_images: seed11 sample0 for every arm, plus worst tip-RMSD sample across all arms; no best-only selection

secondary_symmetry_analysis.reason: The one-sample preflight showed a possible ASP OD1/OD2 label exchange. Before inspecting full-arm outcomes, add a secondary symmetry-aware score permitting only this chemically equivalent exchange. Keep the strict primary score unchanged and retain every atom/case.
secondary_symmetry_analysis.permitted_exchange: ASP OD1 <-> OD2 only; no fitting or other equivalence rules
